activity.notes: After the 1982 election Parliament again chose Somare as Prime Minister. His second prime-ministerial term ended with a vote of no confidence on 21 November 1985.

sources.title: Papua New Guinea Department of Foreign Affairs — PNG History
sources.citation_text: PNG's Department of Foreign Affairs states that Parliament again chose Somare as Prime Minister after the 1982 election and that his government fell to a no-confidence vote in November 1985.

sources.title: ANU Press — PNG prime ministers table
sources.citation_text: ANU gives the second Somare term as 2 August 1982 to 21 November 1985.
